access_pathway_details.text: H.E.L.P. apheresis for long/post-COVID is offered in Germany as a self-pay service (IGeL); statutory health insurance covers H.E.L.P. apheresis only for certain lipid metabolism disorders. IGeL-Monitor rates its benefit 'unclear' as no studies were found.

residency_travel_notes.text: The 2022 BMJ/ITV investigation reported patients travelling to private clinics in Germany for apheresis.

risk_notes.text: A phase II double-blind randomized trial (Nature Communications 2025) of six sessions of therapeutic plasma exchange vs sham in 50 people with post-COVID condition found no difference between groups in any efficacy parameter.

cost_notes.text: Costs €1,300–2,300 per session, and several sessions are usually offered.

arbitrage_summary.text: Germany: self-pay apheresis for long COVID available from private practices; benefit unproven.

evidence.title: Plasma exchange therapy for the post COVID-19 condition: a phase II, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized trial (Nature Communications 2025;16:1929)
evidence.quote: fifty subjects with PCC were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive six sessions of either TPE or a sham plasma exchange ... There were no diferences between groups in any of the efficacy parameters evaluated.

evidence.title: Pavilion Health Today (13 Jul 2022) reporting the BMJ/ITV investigation into apheresis for long covid
evidence.quote: patients are travelling to private clinics in Cyprus, Germany and Switzerland for apheresis

notes: Cost given in EUR (stored '2k–6k/session' unsupported); USD conversion not applied. Oversight MEDIUM not rated. Legal basis for the practice (German professional law) not separately sourced.

residency_travel_notes.text: The 2022 BMJ/ITV investigation reported patients travelling to private clinics in Switzerland for apheresis.

risk_notes.text: A phase II double-blind randomized trial (Nature Communications 2025) of six sessions of therapeutic plasma exchange vs sham in 50 people with post-COVID condition found no difference between groups in any efficacy parameter.

evidence.title: Plasma exchange therapy for the post COVID-19 condition: a phase II, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized trial (Nature Communications 2025;16:1929)
evidence.quote: fifty subjects with PCC were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive six sessions of either TPE or a sham plasma exchange ... There were no diferences between groups in any of the efficacy parameters evaluated.
